subject: BrightCart POC — throughput & cost snapshot; request for a short quote and 10m call
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: BrightCart POC — throughput & cost snapshot; request for a short quote and 10m call

Hi Asha,

Thanks again for running the two-week POC with us — the team at Redwood really enjoyed working with BrightCart. I wanted to share a concise snapshot of the outcomes and ask a quick favor if you’re comfortable. Attached is a one-page summary (brightcart_poc_summary.pdf) and the raw throughput export (throughput_snapshot.csv).

Top-line results we observed across the pilot workload (average over test window):
- 32% reduction in per-request tail latency (p95) when routed to the optimized routing profile
- 2.1x throughput improvement under steady-state batching vs baseline config
- Estimated token cost savings of ~24% after enabling KV-prefix caching and the suggested quantization profile

Why this matters: BrightCart saw faster end-user responses for product search suggestions and lower unit inference cost during peak traffic — the combination is what made the pilot easy to justify internally.

Quick ask: would BrightCart be willing to share one short line we can use internally and on a brief customer-facing snapshot? Example: "Redwood reduced our inference tail latency and cut unit cost — enabling faster search and measurable savings." If that doesn’t capture it, a one-line variant would be great. Also happy to hop on a 10-minute call to align on exact wording and any logo/attribution constraints.

If you’re fine with it, would you also confirm we can attribute the metrics above to BrightCart and show the BrightCart logo on a short one-pager? If you prefer to route that to legal/branding, happy to connect with whomever is easiest.

Thanks — appreciate it. If convenient, you can pick a 10-minute slot here: https://calendly.com/grace-oconnor/10min

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
